svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 20 lengths of strip: 206 mm for the three 167 mm wide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: strips of a stage, 4 mm more for the two 171 mm ones; ends filed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the bar: 185 mm in the middle (the strip's width plus 9 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: past each edge). Beyond each bar end the strip makes three folds:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: first out 1.4 mm under the plate's high edge, then up 2.3 mm along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the edge, then 6 mm flat over the plate's top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold each in a vice between two steel plates, springing the flap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 5 deg tighter than square so it grips the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bar lies under the wick strip, 1 to 9 mm in from the plate's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: high edge; each ear sits in the 8 mm dry break beside the strip,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the flap flat on the plate's top, clear of the rib and the lip tab.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No adhesive: the clip is slid on from the high edge and lifts off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the wick is pressed flat to the plate; no clip part touches a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rib, a lip tab or the liner (1.5 mm to the nearest).
